 export function reduceCourtVoteMachine(
   state: CourtVoteMachineState,
   event: CourtVoteMachineEvent,
 ): CourtVoteMachineState {
   if (event.type === 'tick') {
     assertNow(event.now);
     // `reveal_closed` means close_reveals already ran at/after the deadline and
     // finalize_tally remains legal afterwards — a clock tick must not expire a
     // ceremony that is one step from finalization (mirrors the DKG machine's
     // exemption of its post-deadline `certified` phase).
     if (
       TERMINAL_PHASES.has(state.phase)
       || state.phase === 'reveal_closed'
       || event.now < state.revealDeadline
     ) {
       return state;
     }
     return {
       ...state,
       phase: 'expired',
       failure: { phase: 'expired', reason: 'The reveal deadline passed before tally finalization.' },
     };
   }
   if (event.type === 'abort') {
     if (TERMINAL_PHASES.has(state.phase)) {
       throw new CourtVoteTransitionError(`cannot abort voting from ${state.phase}`);
     }
     return { ...state, phase: 'aborted', failure: { phase: 'aborted', reason: event.reason } };
   }
   if (TERMINAL_PHASES.has(state.phase)) {
     throw new CourtVoteTransitionError(`cannot process ${event.type} after ${state.phase}`);
   }
 
   if (event.type === 'accept_commit') {
     assertBeforeDeadline(event.now, state.commitDeadline, 'vote commit arrived at or after the commit deadline');
     assertParticipant(state, event.idx);
     if (state.phase !== 'commit_open') {
       throw new CourtVoteTransitionError(`cannot accept vote commits during ${state.phase}`);
     }
     if (!HEX_32.test(event.commitHash) || !HEX_32.test(event.eventId)) {
       throw new CourtVoteTransitionError('vote commit hash and event id must be 32-byte lowercase hex');
     }
     const existing = state.commits.find((c) => c.idx === event.idx);
     if (existing) {
       if (existing.commitHash === event.commitHash && existing.eventId === event.eventId) {
         return state;
       }
       throw new CourtVoteTransitionError(
         `participant ${event.idx} published a conflicting vote commit`,
       );
     }
     return {
       ...state,
       commits: [...state.commits, { idx: event.idx, commitHash: event.commitHash, eventId: event.eventId }],
     };
   }
 
   if (event.type === 'close_commits') {
     assertNow(event.now);
     if (state.phase !== 'commit_open') {
       throw new CourtVoteTransitionError(`cannot close vote commits during ${state.phase}`);
     }
     if (event.now < state.commitDeadline) {
       throw new CourtVoteTransitionError('cannot close vote commits before the commit deadline');
     }
     return { ...state, phase: 'commit_closed' };
   }
 
   if (event.type === 'open_reveals') {
     assertNow(event.now);
     if (state.phase !== 'commit_closed') {
       throw new CourtVoteTransitionError(`cannot open vote reveals during ${state.phase}`);
     }
     return { ...state, phase: 'reveal_open' };
   }
 
   if (event.type === 'accept_reveal') {
     assertBeforeDeadline(event.now, state.revealDeadline, 'vote reveal arrived at or after the reveal deadline');
     assertParticipant(state, event.idx);
     if (state.phase !== 'reveal_open') {
       throw new CourtVoteTransitionError(`cannot accept vote reveals during ${state.phase}`);
     }
     if (!state.allowedOutcomes.includes(event.outcome)) {
       throw new CourtVoteTransitionError('vote reveal names an outcome outside the frozen allowlist');
     }
     if (!HEX_32.test(event.salt) || !HEX_32.test(event.eventId)) {
       throw new CourtVoteTransitionError('vote reveal salt and event id must be 32-byte lowercase hex');
     }
     const commit = state.commits.find((c) => c.idx === event.idx);
     if (!commit) {
       throw new CourtVoteTransitionError(
         `participant ${event.idx} revealed without a prior session commit`,
       );
     }
     const expected = hashCourtVoteCommit({
       sessionHash: state.sessionHash,
       outcome: event.outcome,
       salt: event.salt,
     });
     if (expected !== commit.commitHash) {
       throw new CourtVoteTransitionError(
         `vote reveal from participant ${event.idx} does not match its commit`,
       );
     }
     const existing = state.reveals.find((r) => r.idx === event.idx);
     if (existing) {
       if (
         existing.outcome === event.outcome &&
         existing.salt === event.salt &&
         existing.eventId === event.eventId
       ) {
         return state;
       }
       throw new CourtVoteTransitionError(
         `participant ${event.idx} published a conflicting vote reveal`,
       );
     }
     return {
       ...state,
       reveals: [
         ...state.reveals,
         { idx: event.idx, outcome: event.outcome, salt: event.salt, eventId: event.eventId },
       ],
     };
   }
 
   if (event.type === 'close_reveals') {
     assertNow(event.now);
     if (state.phase !== 'reveal_open') {
       throw new CourtVoteTransitionError(`cannot close vote reveals during ${state.phase}`);
     }
     if (event.now < state.revealDeadline) {
       throw new CourtVoteTransitionError('cannot close vote reveals before the reveal deadline');
     }
     return { ...state, phase: 'reveal_closed' };
   }
 
   if (event.type === 'finalize_tally') {
     assertNow(event.now);
     if (state.phase !== 'reveal_closed') {
       throw new CourtVoteTransitionError(`cannot finalize the tally during ${state.phase}`);
     }
     if (state.reveals.length === 0) {
       throw new CourtVoteTransitionError('cannot finalize a verdict without any valid reveal');
     }
     const counts = new Map<string, string[]>();
     for (const reveal of state.reveals) {
       const list = counts.get(reveal.outcome) ?? [];
       list.push(reveal.eventId);
       counts.set(reveal.outcome, list);
     }
     let winner = '';
     let winnerCount = -1;
     for (const [outcome, eventIds] of counts.entries()) {
       if (
         eventIds.length > winnerCount ||
         (eventIds.length === winnerCount && outcome < winner)
       ) {
         winner = outcome;
         winnerCount = eventIds.length;
       }
     }
     const supportingEventIds = [...(counts.get(winner) ?? [])].sort();
     const verdict: CourtVerdict = {
       outcome: winner,
       supportingEventIds,
       verdictHash: hashCourtVerdict({
         sessionHash: state.sessionHash,
         outcome: winner,
         supportingEventIds,
       }),
     };
     return { ...state, phase: 'tally_final', verdict };
   }
 
   return state;
 }

# Coercible session hash can poison reveal processing
**#240121**
- Severity: Low
- Validity: Unreviewed
## Source locations
### `courtVoteMachine.ts` (4 locations)
#### Lines 102-103 — _The regex alone does not establish primitive-string type._

```
const textEncoder = new TextEncoder();
const HEX_32 = /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/;
```
⋯
#### Lines 208-210 — _Creation applies the coercive regex without a type guard._

```
  if (!HEX_32.test(params.sessionHash)) {
    throw new CourtVoteTransitionError('sessionHash must be 32-byte lowercase hex');
  }
```
⋯
#### Lines 251-260 — _The original unchecked sessionHash value is stored in the returned state._ — _The original unchecked value is persisted as `sessionHash`._

```
  return {
    sessionHash: params.sessionHash,
    participantIndices: participants,
    allowedOutcomes: outcomes,
    commitDeadline: params.commitDeadline,
    revealDeadline: params.revealDeadline,
    phase: 'commit_open',
    commits: [],
    reveals: [],
  };
```
⋯
#### Lines 357-362 — _Reveal processing hashes the stored sessionHash before admitting the reveal._ — _Reveal handling later uses the persisted value in canonical commitment hashing._

```
    const expected = hashCourtVoteCommit({
      sessionHash: state.sessionHash,
      outcome: event.outcome,
      salt: event.salt,
    });
    if (expected !== commit.commitHash) {
```
### `courtSession.ts`
#### Lines 433-439 — _CanonicalWriter.hex forwards its value to the strict hex decoder._

```
  text(value: string): void {
    this.bytes(textEncoder.encode(value));
  }

  hex(value: string): void {
    this.bytes(hexToBytes(value));
  }
```
## Description

Creation validates `params.sessionHash` with `HEX_32.test`, which coerces values to strings instead of requiring a primitive string. Consequently, a boxed string or another coercible object that renders as 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters can pass validation. The code then persists the original non-string value in `state.sessionHash`. During reveal handling, `hashCourtVoteCommit` receives that persisted value and ultimately passes it to `CanonicalWriter.hex`, whose hex-decoding path requires a string. The ceremony can therefore be created successfully but throw when an otherwise valid reveal attempts commitment recomputation; creation should require `typeof params.sessionHash === 'string'` before storing it.
## Root cause

`sessionHash` is accepted through coercive regex validation and persisted without first enforcing `typeof params.sessionHash === 'string'`.
## Impact

A caller that can provide construction parameters can create and persist a vote state that cannot process valid reveal transitions. Once commitments and phase changes have occurred, the affected ceremony cannot reach its verdict through normal reveals and must be repaired or recreated.
## Proof of concept
### Test case

```
// Copyright © 2026 baocommunity — licenced under AGPL-3.0 (see LICENSE.txt).

import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';

import {
  createCourtVoteMachine,
  hashCourtVoteCommit,
  reduceCourtVoteMachine,
  type CourtVoteMachineState,
} from '../courtVoteMachine';

const SESSION = '11'.repeat(32);
const SALT = 'aa'.repeat(32);
const COMMIT_EVENT = 'd1'.repeat(32);
const REVEAL_EVENT = 'e1'.repeat(32);
const COMMIT_DEADLINE = 200;
const REVEAL_DEADLINE = 400;

function createVoteState(sessionHash: string): CourtVoteMachineState {
  return createCourtVoteMachine({
    sessionHash,
    participantIndices: [1],
    allowedOutcomes: ['no', 'yes'],
    commitDeadline: COMMIT_DEADLINE,
    revealDeadline: REVEAL_DEADLINE,
  });
}

function addMatchingCommit(state: CourtVoteMachineState): CourtVoteMachineState {
  return reduceCourtVoteMachine(state, {
    type: 'accept_commit',
    idx: 1,
    commitHash: hashCourtVoteCommit({ sessionHash: SESSION, outcome: 'yes', salt: SALT }),
    eventId: COMMIT_EVENT,
    now: 100,
  });
}

function openReveals(state: CourtVoteMachineState): CourtVoteMachineState {
  state = reduceCourtVoteMachine(state, { type: 'close_commits', now: COMMIT_DEADLINE });
  return reduceCourtVoteMachine(state, { type: 'open_reveals', now: COMMIT_DEADLINE + 1 });
}

const matchingReveal = {
  type: 'accept_reveal' as const,
  idx: 1,
  outcome: 'yes',
  salt: SALT,
  eventId: REVEAL_EVENT,
  now: 300,
};

describe('PoC: coercible sessionHash poisons vote reveal processing', () => {
  it('accepts a boxed session hash at creation but later throws while recomputing a valid reveal commitment', () => {
    // Control path: the same textual session hash works when it is a primitive string.
    let control = createVoteState(SESSION);
    control = addMatchingCommit(control);
    control = openReveals(control);
    control = reduceCourtVoteMachine(control, matchingReveal);
    control = reduceCourtVoteMachine(control, { type: 'close_reveals', now: REVEAL_DEADLINE });
    control = reduceCourtVoteMachine(control, { type: 'finalize_tally', now: REVEAL_DEADLINE + 1 });
    expect(control.phase).toBe('tally_final');
    expect(control.verdict?.outcome).toBe('yes');

    // Exploit path: RegExp.test coerces this object to the same 64-char hex text,
    // and createCourtVoteMachine persists the original object in state.sessionHash.
    const boxedSessionHash = new String(SESSION) as unknown as string;
    let poisoned = createVoteState(boxedSessionHash);
    expect(typeof poisoned.sessionHash).toBe('object');

    poisoned = addMatchingCommit(poisoned);
    expect(poisoned.commits).toHaveLength(1);
    poisoned = openReveals(poisoned);
    expect(poisoned.phase).toBe('reveal_open');

    // The reveal is otherwise valid and matches the committed primitive session hash,
    // but the reducer now feeds the persisted boxed object into CanonicalWriter.hex.
    expect(() => reduceCourtVoteMachine(poisoned, matchingReveal)).toThrow();
    expect(poisoned.reveals).toHaveLength(0);

    // With no admissible reveal, the ceremony can be closed but cannot produce a verdict.
    const closed = reduceCourtVoteMachine(poisoned, { type: 'close_reveals', now: REVEAL_DEADLINE });
    expect(closed.phase).toBe('reveal_closed');
    expect(() =>
      reduceCourtVoteMachine(closed, { type: 'finalize_tally', now: REVEAL_DEADLINE + 1 }),
    ).toThrow(/without any valid reveal/);
  });
});
```

## Remediation
### Explanation

Require sessionHash to be a primitive string before regex validation, preventing coercible objects from being accepted and persisted into vote state.
### Patch

```diff
diff --git a/courtVoteMachine.ts b/courtVoteMachine.ts
--- a/courtVoteMachine.ts
+++ b/courtVoteMachine.ts
@@ -1,439 +1,439 @@

  * participant may commit exactly once, a reveal must match that participant's
  * exact session-bound commit, and the tally input is the deterministic set of
  * valid reveals at the close boundary.
  *
  * This module performs no network or Nostr signature verification; the event
  * boundary must authenticate authors and roster indices before dispatching
  * events into the reducer.

 import { sha256 } from '@noble/hashes/sha2.js';
 import { bytesToHex } from '@noble/hashes/utils.js';
 import { CanonicalWriter } from './courtSession';
 
 export const COURT_VOTE_COMMIT_DOMAIN = 'BAO-Court/VoteCommit/v1';
 export const COURT_VERDICT_DOMAIN = 'BAO-Court/Verdict/v1';
 export const COURT_DISPUTE_VERDICT_DOMAIN = 'BAO-Court/DisputeVerdict/v1';
 
 export type CourtVotePhase =
   | 'commit_open'
   | 'commit_closed'
   | 'reveal_open'
   | 'reveal_closed'
   | 'tally_final'
   | 'expired'
   | 'aborted';
 
 export interface CourtVoteFailure {
   readonly phase: 'expired' | 'aborted';
   readonly reason: string;
 }
 
 export interface CourtVoteCommitRecord {
   readonly idx: number;
   readonly commitHash: string;
   readonly eventId: string;
 }
 
 export interface CourtVoteRevealRecord {
   readonly idx: number;
   readonly outcome: string;
   readonly salt: string;
   readonly eventId: string;
 }
 
 export interface CourtVerdict {
   readonly outcome: string;
   /** Supporting reveal event ids, sorted lexicographically for canonical hashing. */
   readonly supportingEventIds: readonly string[];
   readonly verdictHash: string;
 }
 
 export interface CourtVoteMachineState {
   readonly sessionHash: string;
   readonly participantIndices: readonly number[];
   readonly allowedOutcomes: readonly string[];
   readonly commitDeadline: number;
   readonly revealDeadline: number;
   readonly phase: CourtVotePhase;
   readonly commits: readonly CourtVoteCommitRecord[];
   readonly reveals: readonly CourtVoteRevealRecord[];

   readonly failure?: CourtVoteFailure;

 export type CourtVoteMachineEvent =
   | {
       readonly type: 'accept_commit';
       readonly idx: number;
       readonly commitHash: string;
       readonly eventId: string;
       readonly now: number;
     }
   | { readonly type: 'close_commits'; readonly now: number }

       readonly type: 'accept_reveal';
       readonly idx: number;
       readonly outcome: string;
       readonly salt: string;
       readonly eventId: string;

     }

   | { readonly type: 'finalize_tally'; readonly now: number }
   | { readonly type: 'tick'; readonly now: number }
   | { readonly type: 'abort'; readonly reason: string };
 
 export class CourtVoteTransitionError extends Error {
   constructor(message: string) {
     super(message);
     this.name = 'CourtVoteTransitionError';
   }
 }
 
 const textEncoder = new TextEncoder();
 const HEX_32 = /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/;
 const MAX_OUTCOMES = 256;
 const MAX_OUTCOME_BYTES = 256;
 
 const TERMINAL_PHASES = new Set<CourtVotePhase>(['tally_final', 'expired', 'aborted']);
 
 /**
  * Canonical session-bound vote commitment hash.
  *
  * Binding the session hash into every commit makes votes unreplayable across
  * disputes, attempts, and crypto suites. The encoding is length-prefixed so
  * outcome/salt boundaries can never be ambiguous.
  */
 export function hashCourtVoteCommit(params: {
   readonly sessionHash: string;
   readonly outcome: string;
   readonly salt: string;
 }): string {
   const writer = new CanonicalWriter();
   writer.hex(params.sessionHash);
   writer.text(params.outcome);
   writer.hex(params.salt);
   return digestDomain(COURT_VOTE_COMMIT_DOMAIN, writer.finish());
 }
 
 /**
  * Canonical verdict hash binding the session, the winning outcome, and the
  * exact supporting reveal event ids.
  */
 export function hashCourtVerdict(params: {
   readonly sessionHash: string;
   readonly outcome: string;
   readonly supportingEventIds: readonly string[];
 }): string {
   const writer = new CanonicalWriter();
   writer.hex(params.sessionHash);
   writer.text(params.outcome);
   writer.u32(params.supportingEventIds.length);
   for (const eventId of params.supportingEventIds) {
     writer.hex(eventId);
   }
   return digestDomain(COURT_VERDICT_DOMAIN, writer.finish());
 }
 
 function digestDomain(domain: string, encoded: Uint8Array): string {
   const prefix = textEncoder.encode(domain);
   const input = new Uint8Array(prefix.length + encoded.length);
   input.set(prefix, 0);
   input.set(encoded, prefix.length);
   return bytesToHex(sha256(input));
 }
 
 /**
  * Canonical dispute verdict commitment — the statement a kind-39007
  * attestation binds into its signed message.
  *
  * `H(DisputeVerdict/v1, disputeId, outcome, count, sorted reveal event ids)`
  * over canonical length-prefixed fields. Order-independent (event ids are
  * sorted before hashing) and unambiguous, so every juror, coordinator, and
  * observer derives the same commitment from the same public vote ledger. Any
  * observer can recompute it from the attestation's supporting `e` tags and
  * verify the court really attested the tally winner.
  */
 export function hashDisputeVerdict(params: {
   readonly disputeId: string;
   readonly outcome: string;
   readonly supportingEventIds: readonly string[];
 }): string {
   const writer = new CanonicalWriter();
   writer.hex(params.disputeId);
   writer.text(params.outcome);
   const sorted = [...params.supportingEventIds].sort();
   writer.u32(sorted.length);
   for (const id of sorted) {
     writer.hex(id);
   }
   return digestDomain(COURT_DISPUTE_VERDICT_DOMAIN, writer.finish());

   if (!Number.isSafeInteger(now) || now < 0) {
     throw new CourtVoteTransitionError('now must be a non-negative Unix timestamp');

   }

   state: CourtVoteMachineState,
   event: CourtVoteMachineEvent,

       ...state,
       phase: 'expired',
       failure: { phase: 'expired', reason: 'The reveal deadline passed before tally finalization.' },

       if (existing.commitHash === event.commitHash && existing.eventId === event.eventId) {
         return state;
       }
       throw new CourtVoteTransitionError(
         `participant ${event.idx} published a conflicting vote commit`,
       );
     }

       ...state,
       commits: [...state.commits, { idx: event.idx, commitHash: event.commitHash, eventId: event.eventId }],
     };
   }

     assertNow(event.now);
     if (state.phase !== 'commit_open') {
       throw new CourtVoteTransitionError(`cannot close vote commits during ${state.phase}`);
     }
     if (event.now < state.commitDeadline) {
       throw new CourtVoteTransitionError('cannot close vote commits before the commit deadline');
     }
     return { ...state, phase: 'commit_closed' };
   }

     assertNow(event.now);
     if (state.phase !== 'commit_closed') {
       throw new CourtVoteTransitionError(`cannot open vote reveals during ${state.phase}`);
     }
     return { ...state, phase: 'reveal_open' };
   }
 
   if (event.type === 'accept_reveal') {
     assertBeforeDeadline(event.now, state.revealDeadline, 'vote reveal arrived at or after the reveal deadline');
     assertParticipant(state, event.idx);
     if (state.phase !== 'reveal_open') {
       throw new CourtVoteTransitionError(`cannot accept vote reveals during ${state.phase}`);
     }
     if (!state.allowedOutcomes.includes(event.outcome)) {
       throw new CourtVoteTransitionError('vote reveal names an outcome outside the frozen allowlist');
     }
     if (!HEX_32.test(event.salt) || !HEX_32.test(event.eventId)) {
       throw new CourtVoteTransitionError('vote reveal salt and event id must be 32-byte lowercase hex');
     }

         `participant ${event.idx} revealed without a prior session commit`,
       );
     }

       sessionHash: state.sessionHash,
       outcome: event.outcome,
       salt: event.salt,
     });
     if (expected !== commit.commitHash) {
       throw new CourtVoteTransitionError(
         `vote reveal from participant ${event.idx} does not match its commit`,
       );
     }
     const existing = state.reveals.find((r) => r.idx === event.idx);
     if (existing) {
       if (
         existing.outcome === event.outcome &&
         existing.salt === event.salt &&
         existing.eventId === event.eventId
       ) {
         return state;
       }
       throw new CourtVoteTransitionError(
         `participant ${event.idx} published a conflicting vote reveal`,
       );
     }
     return {
       ...state,
       reveals: [
         ...state.reveals,
         { idx: event.idx, outcome: event.outcome, salt: event.salt, eventId: event.eventId },
       ],
     };
   }
 
   if (event.type === 'close_reveals') {
     assertNow(event.now);
     if (state.phase !== 'reveal_open') {
       throw new CourtVoteTransitionError(`cannot close vote reveals during ${state.phase}`);
     }
     if (event.now < state.revealDeadline) {
       throw new CourtVoteTransitionError('cannot close vote reveals before the reveal deadline');
     }
     return { ...state, phase: 'reveal_closed' };
   }
 
   if (event.type === 'finalize_tally') {
     assertNow(event.now);
     if (state.phase !== 'reveal_closed') {
       throw new CourtVoteTransitionError(`cannot finalize the tally during ${state.phase}`);
     }
     if (state.reveals.length === 0) {
       throw new CourtVoteTransitionError('cannot finalize a verdict without any valid reveal');
     }
     const counts = new Map<string, string[]>();
     for (const reveal of state.reveals) {
       const list = counts.get(reveal.outcome) ?? [];
       list.push(reveal.eventId);
       counts.set(reveal.outcome, list);
     }
     let winner = '';
     let winnerCount = -1;
     for (const [outcome, eventIds] of counts.entries()) {
       if (
         eventIds.length > winnerCount ||
         (eventIds.length === winnerCount && outcome < winner)
       ) {
         winner = outcome;
         winnerCount = eventIds.length;
       }
     }
     const supportingEventIds = [...(counts.get(winner) ?? [])].sort();
     const verdict: CourtVerdict = {
       outcome: winner,
       supportingEventIds,
       verdictHash: hashCourtVerdict({
         sessionHash: state.sessionHash,
         outcome: winner,
         supportingEventIds,
       }),
     };
     return { ...state, phase: 'tally_final', verdict };
   }
 
   return state;
 }

# Coercible reveal IDs can block vote finalization
**#240122**
- Severity: Low
- Validity: Unreviewed
## Source locations

### `courtSession.ts`
#### Lines 437-439 — _Canonical hex encoding calls `hexToBytes` on the value._

```
  hex(value: string): void {
    this.bytes(hexToBytes(value));
  }
```
## Description

Reveal admission applies `HEX_32.test` to `event.eventId` without first requiring a primitive string. Because regular-expression testing coerces its input, a boxed string containing valid 32-byte hexadecimal text can pass validation and be stored directly in `state.reveals`. The commitment check does not prevent this case when `salt` is an ordinary valid string, so the malformed event ID survives until finalization. Finalization collects the stored IDs and supplies them to `hashCourtVerdict`, which canonical-hex encodes each value and rejects the non-primitive value. Require primitive strings before applying the hex validation, or normalize accepted identifiers to primitive strings before persisting them, so the reducer cannot create state that the hash path rejects.
## Root cause

The reducer uses coercive regex validation for persisted `eventId` values while the later canonical hashing path requires a primitive string.
## Impact

An in-process caller can submit an accepted reveal with a coercible non-string `eventId` and poison the ceremony state. Every subsequent attempt to finalize the tally then throws while hashing the supporting IDs, leaving the ceremony unable to produce its verdict unless the host discards or repairs that state.
## Proof of concept
### Test case

```
// Copyright © 2026 baocommunity — licenced under AGPL-3.0 (see LICENSE.txt).

import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';

import {
  createCourtVoteMachine,
  hashCourtVoteCommit,
  reduceCourtVoteMachine,
  type CourtVoteMachineState,
} from '../courtVoteMachine';

const SESSION = '11'.repeat(32);
const COMMIT_DEADLINE = 200;
const REVEAL_DEADLINE = 400;
const OUTCOME = 'yes';
const SALT = 'aa'.repeat(32);
const COMMIT_EVENT_ID = 'c1'.repeat(32);
const REVEAL_EVENT_ID = 'e1'.repeat(32);

function freshMachine(): CourtVoteMachineState {
  return createCourtVoteMachine({
    sessionHash: SESSION,
    participantIndices: [1, 2],
    allowedOutcomes: ['no', OUTCOME],
    commitDeadline: COMMIT_DEADLINE,
    revealDeadline: REVEAL_DEADLINE,
  });
}

function openRevealPhase(state: CourtVoteMachineState): CourtVoteMachineState {
  state = reduceCourtVoteMachine(state, {
    type: 'accept_commit',
    idx: 1,
    commitHash: hashCourtVoteCommit({ sessionHash: SESSION, outcome: OUTCOME, salt: SALT }),
    eventId: COMMIT_EVENT_ID,
    now: COMMIT_DEADLINE - 1,
  });
  state = reduceCourtVoteMachine(state, { type: 'close_commits', now: COMMIT_DEADLINE });
  return reduceCourtVoteMachine(state, { type: 'open_reveals', now: COMMIT_DEADLINE + 1 });
}

describe('PoC: coerced reveal IDs block vote finalization', () => {
  it('admits a boxed hex reveal id through the reducer and later throws while finalizing the verdict hash', () => {
    const cleanFinal = reduceCourtVoteMachine(
      reduceCourtVoteMachine(
        reduceCourtVoteMachine(openRevealPhase(freshMachine()), {
          type: 'accept_reveal',
          idx: 1,
          outcome: OUTCOME,
          salt: SALT,
          eventId: REVEAL_EVENT_ID,
          now: COMMIT_DEADLINE + 2,
        }),
        { type: 'close_reveals', now: REVEAL_DEADLINE },
      ),
      { type: 'finalize_tally', now: REVEAL_DEADLINE + 1 },
    );
    expect(cleanFinal.verdict).toBeDefined();

    const boxedRevealId = new String(REVEAL_EVENT_ID) as unknown as string;
    const poisoned = reduceCourtVoteMachine(openRevealPhase(freshMachine()), {
      type: 'accept_reveal',
      idx: 1,
      outcome: OUTCOME,
      salt: SALT,
      eventId: boxedRevealId,
      now: COMMIT_DEADLINE + 2,
    });

    expect(poisoned.reveals).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(typeof poisoned.reveals[0]?.eventId).toBe('object');

    const closedPoisoned = reduceCourtVoteMachine(poisoned, {
      type: 'close_reveals',
      now: REVEAL_DEADLINE,
    });
    expect(closedPoisoned.phase).toBe('reveal_closed');

    expect(() =>
      reduceCourtVoteMachine(closedPoisoned, {
        type: 'finalize_tally',
        now: REVEAL_DEADLINE + 1,
      }),
    ).toThrow();
    expect(() =>
      reduceCourtVoteMachine(closedPoisoned, {
        type: 'finalize_tally',
        now: REVEAL_DEADLINE + 2,
      }),
    ).toThrow();
  });
});
```

## Remediation
### Explanation

Reject non-primitive reveal event IDs before coercive regex validation, preventing boxed strings from being persisted and later breaking canonical verdict hashing.
### Patch

```diff
diff --git a/courtVoteMachine.ts b/courtVoteMachine.ts
--- a/courtVoteMachine.ts
+++ b/courtVoteMachine.ts
@@ -1,439 +1,443 @@

 /**
  * Pure fail-closed state machine for one BAO Court voting ceremony.
  *

  * tally_final. The allowed outcome set is frozen at creation, each roster
  * participant may commit exactly once, a reveal must match that participant's
  * exact session-bound commit, and the tally input is the deterministic set of
  * valid reveals at the close boundary.
  *
  * This module performs no network or Nostr signature verification; the event
  * boundary must authenticate authors and roster indices before dispatching
  * events into the reducer.

 import { sha256 } from '@noble/hashes/sha2.js';
 import { bytesToHex } from '@noble/hashes/utils.js';
 import { CanonicalWriter } from './courtSession';
 
 export const COURT_VOTE_COMMIT_DOMAIN = 'BAO-Court/VoteCommit/v1';
 export const COURT_VERDICT_DOMAIN = 'BAO-Court/Verdict/v1';
 export const COURT_DISPUTE_VERDICT_DOMAIN = 'BAO-Court/DisputeVerdict/v1';
 
 export type CourtVotePhase =
   | 'commit_open'
   | 'commit_closed'
   | 'reveal_open'
   | 'reveal_closed'

   readonly phase: 'expired' | 'aborted';
   readonly reason: string;

   readonly idx: number;
   readonly commitHash: string;
   readonly eventId: string;
 }
 
 export interface CourtVoteRevealRecord {
   readonly idx: number;
   readonly outcome: string;
   readonly salt: string;
   readonly eventId: string;
 }
 
 export interface CourtVerdict {
   readonly outcome: string;
   /** Supporting reveal event ids, sorted lexicographically for canonical hashing. */
   readonly supportingEventIds: readonly string[];
   readonly verdictHash: string;
 }
 
 export interface CourtVoteMachineState {
   readonly sessionHash: string;
   readonly participantIndices: readonly number[];
   readonly allowedOutcomes: readonly string[];
   readonly commitDeadline: number;
   readonly revealDeadline: number;
   readonly phase: CourtVotePhase;
   readonly commits: readonly CourtVoteCommitRecord[];
   readonly reveals: readonly CourtVoteRevealRecord[];
   readonly verdict?: CourtVerdict;
   readonly failure?: CourtVoteFailure;
 }
 
 export type CourtVoteMachineEvent =
   | {
       readonly type: 'accept_commit';
       readonly idx: number;
       readonly commitHash: string;
       readonly eventId: string;
       readonly now: number;
     }
   | { readonly type: 'close_commits'; readonly now: number }
   | { readonly type: 'open_reveals'; readonly now: number }
   | {
       readonly type: 'accept_reveal';
       readonly idx: number;
       readonly outcome: string;
       readonly salt: string;
       readonly eventId: string;
       readonly now: number;
     }
   | { readonly type: 'close_reveals'; readonly now: number }
   | { readonly type: 'finalize_tally'; readonly now: number }
   | { readonly type: 'tick'; readonly now: number }
   | { readonly type: 'abort'; readonly reason: string };
 
 export class CourtVoteTransitionError extends Error {
   constructor(message: string) {
     super(message);
     this.name = 'CourtVoteTransitionError';
   }
 }
 
 const textEncoder = new TextEncoder();
 const HEX_32 = /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/;
 const MAX_OUTCOMES = 256;
 const MAX_OUTCOME_BYTES = 256;
 
 const TERMINAL_PHASES = new Set<CourtVotePhase>(['tally_final', 'expired', 'aborted']);
 
 /**
  * Canonical session-bound vote commitment hash.
  *
  * Binding the session hash into every commit makes votes unreplayable across
  * disputes, attempts, and crypto suites. The encoding is length-prefixed so
  * outcome/salt boundaries can never be ambiguous.
  */
 export function hashCourtVoteCommit(params: {
   readonly sessionHash: string;
   readonly outcome: string;
   readonly salt: string;
 }): string {
   const writer = new CanonicalWriter();
   writer.hex(params.sessionHash);
   writer.text(params.outcome);
   writer.hex(params.salt);
   return digestDomain(COURT_VOTE_COMMIT_DOMAIN, writer.finish());
 }
 
 /**
  * Canonical verdict hash binding the session, the winning outcome, and the
  * exact supporting reveal event ids.
  */
 export function hashCourtVerdict(params: {
   readonly sessionHash: string;
   readonly outcome: string;
   readonly supportingEventIds: readonly string[];
 }): string {
   const writer = new CanonicalWriter();
   writer.hex(params.sessionHash);
   writer.text(params.outcome);
   writer.u32(params.supportingEventIds.length);
   for (const eventId of params.supportingEventIds) {
     writer.hex(eventId);
   }
   return digestDomain(COURT_VERDICT_DOMAIN, writer.finish());
 }
 
 function digestDomain(domain: string, encoded: Uint8Array): string {
   const prefix = textEncoder.encode(domain);
   const input = new Uint8Array(prefix.length + encoded.length);
   input.set(prefix, 0);
   input.set(encoded, prefix.length);
   return bytesToHex(sha256(input));
 }
 
 /**
  * Canonical dispute verdict commitment — the statement a kind-39007
  * attestation binds into its signed message.
  *
  * `H(DisputeVerdict/v1, disputeId, outcome, count, sorted reveal event ids)`
  * over canonical length-prefixed fields. Order-independent (event ids are
  * sorted before hashing) and unambiguous, so every juror, coordinator, and
  * observer derives the same commitment from the same public vote ledger. Any
  * observer can recompute it from the attestation's supporting `e` tags and
  * verify the court really attested the tally winner.
  */
 export function hashDisputeVerdict(params: {
   readonly disputeId: string;
   readonly outcome: string;
   readonly supportingEventIds: readonly string[];
 }): string {
   const writer = new CanonicalWriter();
   writer.hex(params.disputeId);
   writer.text(params.outcome);
   const sorted = [...params.supportingEventIds].sort();
   writer.u32(sorted.length);
   for (const id of sorted) {
     writer.hex(id);
   }
   return digestDomain(COURT_DISPUTE_VERDICT_DOMAIN, writer.finish());

 function assertNow(now: number): void {
   if (!Number.isSafeInteger(now) || now < 0) {
     throw new CourtVoteTransitionError('now must be a non-negative Unix timestamp');
   }
 }
 
 function assertParticipant(state: CourtVoteMachineState, idx: number): void {
   if (!state.participantIndices.includes(idx)) {
     throw new CourtVoteTransitionError(`voter ${idx} is outside the certified roster`);
   }

 function assertBeforeDeadline(now: number, deadline: number, message: string): void {
   assertNow(now);
   if (now >= deadline) {
     throw new CourtVoteTransitionError(message);
   }
 }
 
 export function createCourtVoteMachine(params: {
   readonly sessionHash: string;
   readonly participantIndices: readonly number[];
   readonly allowedOutcomes: readonly string[];
   readonly commitDeadline: number;
   readonly revealDeadline: number;
 }): CourtVoteMachineState {
   if (!HEX_32.test(params.sessionHash)) {
     throw new CourtVoteTransitionError('sessionHash must be 32-byte lowercase hex');
   }
   if (params.participantIndices.length === 0) {
     throw new CourtVoteTransitionError('voting requires at least one participant');
   }
   const participants = [...params.participantIndices];
   participants.forEach((idx, offset) => {
     if (!Number.isSafeInteger(idx) || idx !== offset + 1) {
       throw new CourtVoteTransitionError('participant indices must be ordered and sequential');
     }
   });
   if (
     !Array.isArray(params.allowedOutcomes) ||
     params.allowedOutcomes.length < 2 ||
     params.allowedOutcomes.length > MAX_OUTCOMES
   ) {
     throw new CourtVoteTransitionError(`allowedOutcomes must contain 2..${MAX_OUTCOMES} outcomes`);
   }
   const outcomes = [...params.allowedOutcomes];
   const seen = new Set<string>();
   for (const outcome of outcomes) {
     if (
       typeof outcome !== 'string' ||
       outcome.length === 0 ||
       textEncoder.encode(outcome).length > MAX_OUTCOME_BYTES
     ) {
       throw new CourtVoteTransitionError('allowed outcomes must be non-empty bounded strings');
     }
     if (seen.has(outcome)) {
       throw new CourtVoteTransitionError('allowed outcomes must be unique');
     }
     seen.add(outcome);
   }
   if (!Number.isSafeInteger(params.commitDeadline) || params.commitDeadline < 1) {
     throw new CourtVoteTransitionError('commitDeadline must be a positive Unix timestamp');
   }
   if (
     !Number.isSafeInteger(params.revealDeadline) ||
     params.revealDeadline <= params.commitDeadline
   ) {
     throw new CourtVoteTransitionError('revealDeadline must be later than commitDeadline');
   }
   return {
     sessionHash: params.sessionHash,
     participantIndices: participants,
     allowedOutcomes: outcomes,
     commitDeadline: params.commitDeadline,
     revealDeadline: params.revealDeadline,
     phase: 'commit_open',
     commits: [],
     reveals: [],

       throw new CourtVoteTransitionError(`cannot close vote commits during ${state.phase}`);

     }

     if (state.phase !== 'commit_closed') {

     }

       throw new CourtVoteTransitionError(`cannot accept vote reveals during ${state.phase}`);

         return state;
       }
       throw new CourtVoteTransitionError(
         `participant ${event.idx} published a conflicting vote reveal`,
       );
     }
     return {
       ...state,
       reveals: [
         ...state.reveals,
         { idx: event.idx, outcome: event.outcome, salt: event.salt, eventId: event.eventId },
       ],
     };
   }
 
   if (event.type === 'close_reveals') {
     assertNow(event.now);
     if (state.phase !== 'reveal_open') {
       throw new CourtVoteTransitionError(`cannot close vote reveals during ${state.phase}`);
     }
     if (event.now < state.revealDeadline) {
       throw new CourtVoteTransitionError('cannot close vote reveals before the reveal deadline');
     }
     return { ...state, phase: 'reveal_closed' };
   }
 
   if (event.type === 'finalize_tally') {
     assertNow(event.now);
     if (state.phase !== 'reveal_closed') {
       throw new CourtVoteTransitionError(`cannot finalize the tally during ${state.phase}`);
     }
     if (state.reveals.length === 0) {
       throw new CourtVoteTransitionError('cannot finalize a verdict without any valid reveal');
     }
     const counts = new Map<string, string[]>();
     for (const reveal of state.reveals) {
       const list = counts.get(reveal.outcome) ?? [];
       list.push(reveal.eventId);
       counts.set(reveal.outcome, list);
     }
     let winner = '';
     let winnerCount = -1;
     for (const [outcome, eventIds] of counts.entries()) {
       if (
         eventIds.length > winnerCount ||
         (eventIds.length === winnerCount && outcome < winner)
       ) {
         winner = outcome;
         winnerCount = eventIds.length;
       }
     }
     const supportingEventIds = [...(counts.get(winner) ?? [])].sort();
     const verdict: CourtVerdict = {
       outcome: winner,
       supportingEventIds,
       verdictHash: hashCourtVerdict({
         sessionHash: state.sessionHash,
         outcome: winner,
         supportingEventIds,
       }),
     };
     return { ...state, phase: 'tally_final', verdict };
   }
 
   return state;
 }

# Malformed Unicode outcomes can bypass commitment binding
**#240123**
- Severity: Medium
- Validity: Unreviewed
## Source locations

```

    this.bytes(textEncoder.encode(value));
  }
```
## Description

The allowlist accepts distinct JavaScript strings without requiring valid Unicode scalar sequences, so a lone surrogate such as `"\uD800"` can coexist with `"\uFFFD"`. Commitments serialize outcomes with `CanonicalWriter.text`, which delegates to `TextEncoder`; this replacement-encodes lone surrogates and therefore produces identical bytes for those two distinct strings. A participant can commit with one allowed raw string and reveal the other, because reveal validation independently accepts the alternate raw allowlist entry and obtains the same commitment digest. The machine then stores the revealed raw string for tallying rather than the string originally supplied to the commitment operation. Consequently, the commitment does not uniquely bind the outcome represented in the final vote ledger.
## Root cause

`allowedOutcomes` permits malformed UTF-16 values even though `TextEncoder`-based commitment serialization is non-injective for lone surrogates.
## Impact

A voter can choose between two distinct allowlisted outcomes after making a commitment when those outcomes collide under UTF-8 replacement encoding. This can alter the recorded tally and potentially the winning verdict, while consumers that preserve or reject malformed UTF-16 may derive inconsistent results.
## Proof of concept
### Test case

```
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';

import {
  createCourtVoteMachine,
  hashCourtVoteCommit,
  reduceCourtVoteMachine,
  type CourtVoteMachineState,
} from '../courtVoteMachine';

const SESSION = '11'.repeat(32);
const COMMIT_DEADLINE = 200;
const REVEAL_DEADLINE = 400;
const SALTS = ['aa'.repeat(32), 'bb'.repeat(32), 'cc'.repeat(32)] as const;
const COMMIT_EVENTS = ['d1'.repeat(32), 'd2'.repeat(32), 'd3'.repeat(32)] as const;
const REVEAL_EVENTS = ['e1'.repeat(32), 'e2'.repeat(32), 'e3'.repeat(32)] as const;

function commit(idx: number, outcome: string) {
  return {
    type: 'accept_commit' as const,
    idx,
    commitHash: hashCourtVoteCommit({ sessionHash: SESSION, outcome, salt: SALTS[idx - 1] }),
    eventId: COMMIT_EVENTS[idx - 1],
    now: 100,
  };
}

function reveal(idx: number, outcome: string) {
  return {
    type: 'accept_reveal' as const,
    idx,
    outcome,
    salt: SALTS[idx - 1],
    eventId: REVEAL_EVENTS[idx - 1],
    now: 300,
  };
}

function openReveals(state: CourtVoteMachineState): CourtVoteMachineState {
  state = reduceCourtVoteMachine(state, { type: 'close_commits', now: COMMIT_DEADLINE });
  return reduceCourtVoteMachine(state, { type: 'open_reveals', now: COMMIT_DEADLINE + 1 });
}

function finalize(state: CourtVoteMachineState): CourtVoteMachineState {
  state = reduceCourtVoteMachine(state, { type: 'close_reveals', now: REVEAL_DEADLINE });
  return reduceCourtVoteMachine(state, { type: 'finalize_tally', now: REVEAL_DEADLINE + 1 });
}

describe('PoC: malformed Unicode outcomes bypass vote commitment binding', () => {
  it('lets the same committed vote be revealed as either colliding allowed outcome and changes the final tally', () => {
    const malformed = String.fromCharCode(0xd800);
    const replacement = String.fromCharCode(0xfffd);

    expect(malformed).not.toBe(replacement);
    expect(Array.from(new TextEncoder().encode(malformed))).toEqual(
      Array.from(new TextEncoder().encode(replacement)),
    );

    const attackerCommitAsMalformed = hashCourtVoteCommit({
      sessionHash: SESSION,
      outcome: malformed,
      salt: SALTS[0],
    });
    const attackerCommitAsReplacement = hashCourtVoteCommit({
      sessionHash: SESSION,
      outcome: replacement,
      salt: SALTS[0],
    });
    expect(attackerCommitAsMalformed).toBe(attackerCommitAsReplacement);

    let base = createCourtVoteMachine({
      sessionHash: SESSION,
      participantIndices: [1, 2, 3],
      allowedOutcomes: [malformed, replacement],
      commitDeadline: COMMIT_DEADLINE,
      revealDeadline: REVEAL_DEADLINE,
    });

    // The attacker (idx 1) publishes one public commitment before knowing which
    // side to support later. Honest voters split one vote to each representation.
    base = reduceCourtVoteMachine(base, commit(1, malformed));
    base = reduceCourtVoteMachine(base, commit(2, malformed));
    base = reduceCourtVoteMachine(base, commit(3, replacement));
    base = openReveals(base);

    let revealCommittedString = base;
    revealCommittedString = reduceCourtVoteMachine(revealCommittedString, reveal(1, malformed));
    revealCommittedString = reduceCourtVoteMachine(revealCommittedString, reveal(2, malformed));
    revealCommittedString = reduceCourtVoteMachine(revealCommittedString, reveal(3, replacement));
    revealCommittedString = finalize(revealCommittedString);

    let revealAlternateString = base;
    revealAlternateString = reduceCourtVoteMachine(revealAlternateString, reveal(1, replacement));
    revealAlternateString = reduceCourtVoteMachine(revealAlternateString, reveal(2, malformed));
    revealAlternateString = reduceCourtVoteMachine(revealAlternateString, reveal(3, replacement));
    revealAlternateString = finalize(revealAlternateString);

    expect(revealCommittedString.phase).toBe('tally_final');
    expect(revealAlternateString.phase).toBe('tally_final');
    expect(revealCommittedString.verdict).toBeDefined();
    expect(revealAlternateString.verdict).toBeDefined();

    // Same pre-reveal commitment state, same attacker salt and commit hash, but
    // accepting the alternate raw string changes the winner recorded by the real
    // reducer. A fix that rejects malformed outcome strings or makes text
    // serialization injective would make creation or the alternate reveal fail.
    expect(revealAlternateString.reveals.find((r) => r.idx === 1)?.outcome).toBe(replacement);
    expect(revealCommittedString.verdict!.outcome).not.toBe(revealAlternateString.verdict!.outcome);
    expect(revealCommittedString.verdict!.supportingEventIds).not.toEqual(
      revealAlternateString.verdict!.supportingEventIds,
    );
  });
});
```

## Remediation
### Explanation

Reject malformed UTF-16 outcome strings when freezing the vote allowlist, ensuring TextEncoder-based canonical serialization remains injective over accepted outcomes and preventing alternate colliding reveals.
### Patch

```diff
diff --git a/courtVoteMachine.ts b/courtVoteMachine.ts
--- a/courtVoteMachine.ts
+++ b/courtVoteMachine.ts
@@ -1,439 +1,454 @@

 /**
  * Pure fail-closed state machine for one BAO Court voting ceremony.
  *
  * Phases: commit_open -> commit_closed -> reveal_open -> reveal_closed ->
  * tally_final. The allowed outcome set is frozen at creation, each roster
  * participant may commit exactly once, a reveal must match that participant's
  * exact session-bound commit, and the tally input is the deterministic set of
  * valid reveals at the close boundary.
  *
  * This module performs no network or Nostr signature verification; the event
  * boundary must authenticate authors and roster indices before dispatching
  * events into the reducer.
  */
 
 import { sha256 } from '@noble/hashes/sha2.js';
 import { bytesToHex } from '@noble/hashes/utils.js';
 import { CanonicalWriter } from './courtSession';
 
 export const COURT_VOTE_COMMIT_DOMAIN = 'BAO-Court/VoteCommit/v1';
 export const COURT_VERDICT_DOMAIN = 'BAO-Court/Verdict/v1';
 export const COURT_DISPUTE_VERDICT_DOMAIN = 'BAO-Court/DisputeVerdict/v1';
 
 export type CourtVotePhase =
   | 'commit_open'
   | 'commit_closed'
   | 'reveal_open'
   | 'reveal_closed'
   | 'tally_final'
   | 'expired'
   | 'aborted';
 
 export interface CourtVoteFailure {
   readonly phase: 'expired' | 'aborted';
   readonly reason: string;
 }
 
 export interface CourtVoteCommitRecord {
   readonly idx: number;
   readonly commitHash: string;
   readonly eventId: string;
 }
 
 export interface CourtVoteRevealRecord {
   readonly idx: number;
   readonly outcome: string;
   readonly salt: string;
   readonly eventId: string;
 }
 
 export interface CourtVerdict {
   readonly outcome: string;
   /** Supporting reveal event ids, sorted lexicographically for canonical hashing. */
   readonly supportingEventIds: readonly string[];
   readonly verdictHash: string;
 }
 
 export interface CourtVoteMachineState {
   readonly sessionHash: string;
   readonly participantIndices: readonly number[];
   readonly allowedOutcomes: readonly string[];
   readonly commitDeadline: number;
   readonly revealDeadline: number;
   readonly phase: CourtVotePhase;
   readonly commits: readonly CourtVoteCommitRecord[];
   readonly reveals: readonly CourtVoteRevealRecord[];
   readonly verdict?: CourtVerdict;
   readonly failure?: CourtVoteFailure;
 }
 
 export type CourtVoteMachineEvent =
   | {
       readonly type: 'accept_commit';
       readonly idx: number;
       readonly commitHash: string;
       readonly eventId: string;
       readonly now: number;
     }
   | { readonly type: 'close_commits'; readonly now: number }
   | { readonly type: 'open_reveals'; readonly now: number }
   | {
       readonly type: 'accept_reveal';
       readonly idx: number;
       readonly outcome: string;
       readonly salt: string;
       readonly eventId: string;
       readonly now: number;
     }
   | { readonly type: 'close_reveals'; readonly now: number }
   | { readonly type: 'finalize_tally'; readonly now: number }
   | { readonly type: 'tick'; readonly now: number }
   | { readonly type: 'abort'; readonly reason: string };
 
 export class CourtVoteTransitionError extends Error {
   constructor(message: string) {
     super(message);
     this.name = 'CourtVoteTransitionError';
   }
 }
 
 const textEncoder = new TextEncoder();
 const HEX_32 = /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/;
 const MAX_OUTCOMES = 256;
 const MAX_OUTCOME_BYTES = 256;
 
+function isWellFormedUnicode(value: string): boolean {
+  for (let index = 0; index < value.length; index += 1) {
+    const codeUnit = value.charCodeAt(index);
+    if (codeUnit >= 0xd800 && codeUnit <= 0xdbff) {
+      const next = value.charCodeAt(index + 1);
+      if (index + 1 >= value.length || next < 0xdc00 || next > 0xdfff) return false;
+      index += 1;
+    } else if (codeUnit >= 0xdc00 && codeUnit <= 0xdfff) {
+      return false;
+    }
+  }
+  return true;
+}
+
 const TERMINAL_PHASES = new Set<CourtVotePhase>(['tally_final', 'expired', 'aborted']);
 
 /**
  * Canonical session-bound vote commitment hash.
  *
  * Binding the session hash into every commit makes votes unreplayable across
  * disputes, attempts, and crypto suites. The encoding is length-prefixed so
  * outcome/salt boundaries can never be ambiguous.
  */
 export function hashCourtVoteCommit(params: {
   readonly sessionHash: string;
   readonly outcome: string;
   readonly salt: string;
 }): string {
   const writer = new CanonicalWriter();
   writer.hex(params.sessionHash);
   writer.text(params.outcome);
   writer.hex(params.salt);
   return digestDomain(COURT_VOTE_COMMIT_DOMAIN, writer.finish());
 }
 
 /**
  * Canonical verdict hash binding the session, the winning outcome, and the
  * exact supporting reveal event ids.
  */
 export function hashCourtVerdict(params: {
   readonly sessionHash: string;
   readonly outcome: string;
   readonly supportingEventIds: readonly string[];
 }): string {
   const writer = new CanonicalWriter();
   writer.hex(params.sessionHash);
   writer.text(params.outcome);
   writer.u32(params.supportingEventIds.length);
   for (const eventId of params.supportingEventIds) {
     writer.hex(eventId);
   }
   return digestDomain(COURT_VERDICT_DOMAIN, writer.finish());
 }
 
 function digestDomain(domain: string, encoded: Uint8Array): string {
   const prefix = textEncoder.encode(domain);
   const input = new Uint8Array(prefix.length + encoded.length);
   input.set(prefix, 0);
   input.set(encoded, prefix.length);
   return bytesToHex(sha256(input));
 }
 
 /**
  * Canonical dispute verdict commitment — the statement a kind-39007
  * attestation binds into its signed message.
  *
  * `H(DisputeVerdict/v1, disputeId, outcome, count, sorted reveal event ids)`
  * over canonical length-prefixed fields. Order-independent (event ids are
  * sorted before hashing) and unambiguous, so every juror, coordinator, and
  * observer derives the same commitment from the same public vote ledger. Any
  * observer can recompute it from the attestation's supporting `e` tags and
  * verify the court really attested the tally winner.
  */
 export function hashDisputeVerdict(params: {
   readonly disputeId: string;
   readonly outcome: string;
   readonly supportingEventIds: readonly string[];
 }): string {
   const writer = new CanonicalWriter();
   writer.hex(params.disputeId);
   writer.text(params.outcome);
   const sorted = [...params.supportingEventIds].sort();
   writer.u32(sorted.length);
   for (const id of sorted) {
     writer.hex(id);
   }
   return digestDomain(COURT_DISPUTE_VERDICT_DOMAIN, writer.finish());
 }
 
 function assertNow(now: number): void {
   if (!Number.isSafeInteger(now) || now < 0) {
     throw new CourtVoteTransitionError('now must be a non-negative Unix timestamp');
   }
 }
 
 function assertParticipant(state: CourtVoteMachineState, idx: number): void {
   if (!state.participantIndices.includes(idx)) {
     throw new CourtVoteTransitionError(`voter ${idx} is outside the certified roster`);
   }
 }
 
 function assertBeforeDeadline(now: number, deadline: number, message: string): void {
   assertNow(now);
   if (now >= deadline) {
     throw new CourtVoteTransitionError(message);
   }
 }
 
 export function createCourtVoteMachine(params: {
   readonly sessionHash: string;
   readonly participantIndices: readonly number[];
   readonly allowedOutcomes: readonly string[];
   readonly commitDeadline: number;
   readonly revealDeadline: number;
 }): CourtVoteMachineState {
   if (!HEX_32.test(params.sessionHash)) {
     throw new CourtVoteTransitionError('sessionHash must be 32-byte lowercase hex');
   }
   if (params.participantIndices.length === 0) {
     throw new CourtVoteTransitionError('voting requires at least one participant');
   }
   const participants = [...params.participantIndices];
   participants.forEach((idx, offset) => {
     if (!Number.isSafeInteger(idx) || idx !== offset + 1) {
       throw new CourtVoteTransitionError('participant indices must be ordered and sequential');
     }
   });
   if (
     !Array.isArray(params.allowedOutcomes) ||
     params.allowedOutcomes.length < 2 ||
     params.allowedOutcomes.length > MAX_OUTCOMES
   ) {
     throw new CourtVoteTransitionError(`allowedOutcomes must contain 2..${MAX_OUTCOMES} outcomes`);
   }
   const outcomes = [...params.allowedOutcomes];
   const seen = new Set<string>();
   for (const outcome of outcomes) {
     if (
       typeof outcome !== 'string' ||
       outcome.length === 0 ||
+      !isWellFormedUnicode(outcome) ||
       textEncoder.encode(outcome).length > MAX_OUTCOME_BYTES
     ) {
       throw new CourtVoteTransitionError('allowed outcomes must be non-empty bounded strings');
     }
     if (seen.has(outcome)) {
       throw new CourtVoteTransitionError('allowed outcomes must be unique');
     }
     seen.add(outcome);
   }
   if (!Number.isSafeInteger(params.commitDeadline) || params.commitDeadline < 1) {
     throw new CourtVoteTransitionError('commitDeadline must be a positive Unix timestamp');
   }
   if (
     !Number.isSafeInteger(params.revealDeadline) ||
     params.revealDeadline <= params.commitDeadline
   ) {
     throw new CourtVoteTransitionError('revealDeadline must be later than commitDeadline');
   }
   return {
     sessionHash: params.sessionHash,
     participantIndices: participants,
     allowedOutcomes: outcomes,
     commitDeadline: params.commitDeadline,
     revealDeadline: params.revealDeadline,
     phase: 'commit_open',
     commits: [],
     reveals: [],
   };
 }
 
 export function reduceCourtVoteMachine(
   state: CourtVoteMachineState,
   event: CourtVoteMachineEvent,
 ): CourtVoteMachineState {
   if (event.type === 'tick') {
     assertNow(event.now);
     // `reveal_closed` means close_reveals already ran at/after the deadline and
     // finalize_tally remains legal afterwards — a clock tick must not expire a
     // ceremony that is one step from finalization (mirrors the DKG machine's
     // exemption of its post-deadline `certified` phase).
     if (
       TERMINAL_PHASES.has(state.phase)
       || state.phase === 'reveal_closed'
       || event.now < state.revealDeadline
     ) {
       return state;
     }
     return {
       ...state,
       phase: 'expired',
       failure: { phase: 'expired', reason: 'The reveal deadline passed before tally finalization.' },
     };
   }
   if (event.type === 'abort') {
     if (TERMINAL_PHASES.has(state.phase)) {
       throw new CourtVoteTransitionError(`cannot abort voting from ${state.phase}`);
     }
     return { ...state, phase: 'aborted', failure: { phase: 'aborted', reason: event.reason } };
   }
   if (TERMINAL_PHASES.has(state.phase)) {
     throw new CourtVoteTransitionError(`cannot process ${event.type} after ${state.phase}`);
   }
 
   if (event.type === 'accept_commit') {
     assertBeforeDeadline(event.now, state.commitDeadline, 'vote commit arrived at or after the commit deadline');
     assertParticipant(state, event.idx);
     if (state.phase !== 'commit_open') {
       throw new CourtVoteTransitionError(`cannot accept vote commits during ${state.phase}`);
     }
     if (!HEX_32.test(event.commitHash) || !HEX_32.test(event.eventId)) {
       throw new CourtVoteTransitionError('vote commit hash and event id must be 32-byte lowercase hex');
     }
     const existing = state.commits.find((c) => c.idx === event.idx);
     if (existing) {
       if (existing.commitHash === event.commitHash && existing.eventId === event.eventId) {
         return state;
       }
       throw new CourtVoteTransitionError(
         `participant ${event.idx} published a conflicting vote commit`,
       );
     }
     return {
       ...state,
       commits: [...state.commits, { idx: event.idx, commitHash: event.commitHash, eventId: event.eventId }],
     };
   }
 
   if (event.type === 'close_commits') {
     assertNow(event.now);
     if (state.phase !== 'commit_open') {
       throw new CourtVoteTransitionError(`cannot close vote commits during ${state.phase}`);
     }
     if (event.now < state.commitDeadline) {
       throw new CourtVoteTransitionError('cannot close vote commits before the commit deadline');
     }
     return { ...state, phase: 'commit_closed' };
   }
 
   if (event.type === 'open_reveals') {
     assertNow(event.now);
     if (state.phase !== 'commit_closed') {
       throw new CourtVoteTransitionError(`cannot open vote reveals during ${state.phase}`);
     }
     return { ...state, phase: 'reveal_open' };
   }
 
   if (event.type === 'accept_reveal') {
     assertBeforeDeadline(event.now, state.revealDeadline, 'vote reveal arrived at or after the reveal deadline');
     assertParticipant(state, event.idx);
     if (state.phase !== 'reveal_open') {
       throw new CourtVoteTransitionError(`cannot accept vote reveals during ${state.phase}`);
     }
     if (!state.allowedOutcomes.includes(event.outcome)) {
       throw new CourtVoteTransitionError('vote reveal names an outcome outside the frozen allowlist');
     }
     if (!HEX_32.test(event.salt) || !HEX_32.test(event.eventId)) {
       throw new CourtVoteTransitionError('vote reveal salt and event id must be 32-byte lowercase hex');
     }
     const commit = state.commits.find((c) => c.idx === event.idx);
     if (!commit) {
       throw new CourtVoteTransitionError(
         `participant ${event.idx} revealed without a prior session commit`,
       );
     }
     const expected = hashCourtVoteCommit({
       sessionHash: state.sessionHash,
       outcome: event.outcome,
       salt: event.salt,
     });
     if (expected !== commit.commitHash) {
       throw new CourtVoteTransitionError(
         `vote reveal from participant ${event.idx} does not match its commit`,
       );
     }
     const existing = state.reveals.find((r) => r.idx === event.idx);
     if (existing) {
       if (
         existing.outcome === event.outcome &&
         existing.salt === event.salt &&
         existing.eventId === event.eventId
       ) {
         return state;
       }
       throw new CourtVoteTransitionError(
         `participant ${event.idx} published a conflicting vote reveal`,
       );
     }
     return {
       ...state,
       reveals: [
         ...state.reveals,
         { idx: event.idx, outcome: event.outcome, salt: event.salt, eventId: event.eventId },
       ],
     };
   }
 
   if (event.type === 'close_reveals') {
     assertNow(event.now);
     if (state.phase !== 'reveal_open') {
       throw new CourtVoteTransitionError(`cannot close vote reveals during ${state.phase}`);
     }
     if (event.now < state.revealDeadline) {
       throw new CourtVoteTransitionError('cannot close vote reveals before the reveal deadline');
     }
     return { ...state, phase: 'reveal_closed' };
   }
 
   if (event.type === 'finalize_tally') {
     assertNow(event.now);
     if (state.phase !== 'reveal_closed') {
       throw new CourtVoteTransitionError(`cannot finalize the tally during ${state.phase}`);
     }
     if (state.reveals.length === 0) {
       throw new CourtVoteTransitionError('cannot finalize a verdict without any valid reveal');
     }
     const counts = new Map<string, string[]>();
     for (const reveal of state.reveals) {
       const list = counts.get(reveal.outcome) ?? [];
       list.push(reveal.eventId);
       counts.set(reveal.outcome, list);
     }
     let winner = '';
     let winnerCount = -1;
     for (const [outcome, eventIds] of counts.entries()) {
       if (
         eventIds.length > winnerCount ||
         (eventIds.length === winnerCount && outcome < winner)
       ) {
         winner = outcome;
         winnerCount = eventIds.length;
       }
     }
     const supportingEventIds = [...(counts.get(winner) ?? [])].sort();
     const verdict: CourtVerdict = {
       outcome: winner,
       supportingEventIds,
       verdictHash: hashCourtVerdict({
         sessionHash: state.sessionHash,
         outcome: winner,
         supportingEventIds,
       }),
     };
     return { ...state, phase: 'tally_final', verdict };
   }
 
   return state;
 }

# Reveal deadline can be bypassed with non-monotonic timestamps
**#240124**
- Severity: High
- Validity: Unreviewed
## Source locations
### `courtVoteMachine.ts` (5 locations)
#### Lines 182-199 — _`assertNow` validates only timestamp shape and `assertBeforeDeadline` compares only the current event timestamp._

```
function assertNow(now: number): void {
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(now) || now < 0) {
    throw new CourtVoteTransitionError('now must be a non-negative Unix timestamp');
  }
}

function assertParticipant(state: CourtVoteMachineState, idx: number): void {
  if (!state.participantIndices.includes(idx)) {
    throw new CourtVoteTransitionError(`voter ${idx} is outside the certified roster`);
  }
}

function assertBeforeDeadline(now: number, deadline: number, message: string): void {
  assertNow(now);
  if (now >= deadline) {
    throw new CourtVoteTransitionError(message);
  }
}

    }
    return { ...state, phase: 'aborted', failure: { phase: 'aborted', reason: event.reason } };

  if (TERMINAL_PHASES.has(state.phase)) {
    throw new CourtVoteTransitionError(`cannot process ${event.type} after ${state.phase}`);

## Description

The state machine allows `open_reveals` from `commit_closed` without checking that `event.now` precedes `revealDeadline`. It also treats timestamps as event-local values: `accept_reveal` checks only the timestamp supplied on that reveal and the state does not retain a maximum observed time. A caller can therefore open the reveal phase after the deadline, submit a cryptographically valid reveal carrying a stale pre-deadline timestamp, then close and finalize the tally using a current timestamp. Because expiration requires a separately dispatched `tick`, event ordering determines whether the machine expires; moreover, a late open and close with no reveals reaches `reveal_closed`, which `tick` intentionally does not expire and which cannot be finalized without a reveal. Enforcing the reveal-window boundary on phase entry and using a monotonic or trusted time source for all deadline-sensitive transitions resolves both the late-admission and stuck-state paths.
## Root cause

`open_reveals` lacks a `revealDeadline` guard, while deadline checks trust independent caller-supplied `event.now` values rather than enforcing monotonic or trusted time across transitions.
## Impact

An actor able to control reducer event ordering and timestamps can include reveals after the reveal window has actually elapsed, changing the records used to derive the verdict. The same deadline bypass can also leave a ceremony permanently in `reveal_closed` with no valid reveal, preventing tally finalization.
## Proof of concept
### Test case

```
// Copyright © 2026 baocommunity — licenced under AGPL-3.0 (see LICENSE.txt).

import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';

import {
  CourtVoteTransitionError,
  createCourtVoteMachine,
  hashCourtVoteCommit,
  reduceCourtVoteMachine,
  type CourtVoteMachineState,
} from '../courtVoteMachine';

const SESSION = '11'.repeat(32);
const COMMIT_DEADLINE = 200;
const REVEAL_DEADLINE = 400;
const SALT = 'aa'.repeat(32);
const COMMIT_EVENT_ID = 'd1'.repeat(32);
const LATE_REVEAL_EVENT_ID = 'e1'.repeat(32);

function initial(): CourtVoteMachineState {
  return createCourtVoteMachine({
    sessionHash: SESSION,
    participantIndices: [1],
    allowedOutcomes: ['accept', 'reject'],
    commitDeadline: COMMIT_DEADLINE,
    revealDeadline: REVEAL_DEADLINE,
  });
}

function committedVote(outcome: string): CourtVoteMachineState {
  return reduceCourtVoteMachine(initial(), {
    type: 'accept_commit',
    idx: 1,
    commitHash: hashCourtVoteCommit({ sessionHash: SESSION, outcome, salt: SALT }),
    eventId: COMMIT_EVENT_ID,
    now: COMMIT_DEADLINE - 1,
  });
}

describe('PoC: reveal deadline bypass with non-monotonic timestamps', () => {
  it('admits a matching reveal after the reveal deadline by reopening with current time and revealing with stale time', () => {
    const realPostDeadlineTime = REVEAL_DEADLINE + 50;

    // If the host dispatches a tick at the same post-deadline time, the ceremony expires.
    // The exploit path below succeeds solely by ordering non-tick events first.
    const ticked = reduceCourtVoteMachine(committedVote('reject'), {
      type: 'tick',
      now: realPostDeadlineTime,
    });
    expect(ticked.phase).toBe('expired');
    expect(() =>
      reduceCourtVoteMachine(ticked, { type: 'open_reveals', now: realPostDeadlineTime }),
    ).toThrow(CourtVoteTransitionError);

    let state = committedVote('reject');

    // Both phase-entry transitions use timestamps after the reveal deadline.
    state = reduceCourtVoteMachine(state, { type: 'close_commits', now: realPostDeadlineTime });
    expect(state.phase).toBe('commit_closed');

    state = reduceCourtVoteMachine(state, { type: 'open_reveals', now: realPostDeadlineTime });
    expect(state.phase).toBe('reveal_open');

    // The reveal itself is submitted only after the late open, but carries a stale
    // event-local timestamp just before the deadline. The reducer does not remember
    // that a later timestamp has already been observed.
    state = reduceCourtVoteMachine(state, {
      type: 'accept_reveal',
      idx: 1,
      outcome: 'reject',
      salt: SALT,
      eventId: LATE_REVEAL_EVENT_ID,
      now: REVEAL_DEADLINE - 1,
    });

    expect(state.phase).toBe('reveal_open');
    expect(state.reveals).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(state.reveals[0]?.eventId).toBe(LATE_REVEAL_EVENT_ID);

    state = reduceCourtVoteMachine(state, { type: 'close_reveals', now: realPostDeadlineTime });
    expect(state.phase).toBe('reveal_closed');

    // A later tick cannot undo reveal_closed; the stale late reveal remains tally input.
    state = reduceCourtVoteMachine(state, { type: 'tick', now: realPostDeadlineTime + 1 });
    expect(state.phase).toBe('reveal_closed');

    const acceptedReveal = state.reveals[0];
    state = reduceCourtVoteMachine(state, { type: 'finalize_tally', now: realPostDeadlineTime + 2 });

    expect(state.phase).toBe('tally_final');
    expect(state.verdict).toBeDefined();
    expect(state.verdict?.outcome).toBe(acceptedReveal?.outcome);
    expect(state.verdict?.supportingEventIds).toEqual(
      state.reveals.map((reveal) => reveal.eventId).sort(),
    );
  });

  it('can also late-open and close an empty reveal ledger into a non-expiring state that cannot finalize', () => {
    const realPostDeadlineTime = REVEAL_DEADLINE + 25;
    let state = committedVote('accept');

    state = reduceCourtVoteMachine(state, { type: 'close_commits', now: realPostDeadlineTime });
    state = reduceCourtVoteMachine(state, { type: 'open_reveals', now: realPostDeadlineTime });
    state = reduceCourtVoteMachine(state, { type: 'close_reveals', now: realPostDeadlineTime });

    expect(state.phase).toBe('reveal_closed');
    expect(state.reveals).toHaveLength(0);

    const afterTick = reduceCourtVoteMachine(state, { type: 'tick', now: realPostDeadlineTime + 1 });
    expect(afterTick.phase).toBe('reveal_closed');

    expect(() =>
      reduceCourtVoteMachine(afterTick, { type: 'finalize_tally', now: realPostDeadlineTime + 2 }),
    ).toThrow(/without any valid reveal/);
  });
});

It demonstrates the reducer-level vulnerability through exported public APIs only: a post-deadline `close_commits`/`open_reveals`, stale pre-deadline `accept_reveal`, post-deadline `close_reveals`, non-expiring `tick`, and `finalize_tally` that derives the verdict from the stale late reveal. It also demonstrates the empty-ledger late-open/close path becoming `reveal_closed`, surviving `tick`, and refusing finalization. The PoC assumes the host boundary can dispatch reducer events with event-local `now` values and can choose event ordering; it does not model Nostr transport/authentication outside `courtVoteMachine.ts`.

PoC validation command completed successfully.
## Remediation
### Explanation

Track the greatest timestamp observed by the vote reducer, reject timestamp rollback on every time-bearing event, and require reveal-phase entry before the reveal deadline. This closes both stale-time reveal admission and late-open empty-ledger paths.
### Patch

```diff
diff --git a/courtVoteMachine.ts b/courtVoteMachine.ts
--- a/courtVoteMachine.ts
+++ b/courtVoteMachine.ts
@@ -1,439 +1,450 @@
 // Copyright © 2026 baocommunity — licenced under AGPL-3.0 (see LICENSE.txt).
 
 /**
  * Pure fail-closed state machine for one BAO Court voting ceremony.
  *
  * Phases: commit_open -> commit_closed -> reveal_open -> reveal_closed ->
  * tally_final. The allowed outcome set is frozen at creation, each roster
  * participant may commit exactly once, a reveal must match that participant's
  * exact session-bound commit, and the tally input is the deterministic set of
  * valid reveals at the close boundary.
  *
  * This module performs no network or Nostr signature verification; the event
  * boundary must authenticate authors and roster indices before dispatching
  * events into the reducer.
  */
 
 import { sha256 } from '@noble/hashes/sha2.js';
 import { bytesToHex } from '@noble/hashes/utils.js';
 import { CanonicalWriter } from './courtSession';
 
 export const COURT_VOTE_COMMIT_DOMAIN = 'BAO-Court/VoteCommit/v1';
 export const COURT_VERDICT_DOMAIN = 'BAO-Court/Verdict/v1';
 export const COURT_DISPUTE_VERDICT_DOMAIN = 'BAO-Court/DisputeVerdict/v1';
 
 export type CourtVotePhase =
   | 'commit_open'
   | 'commit_closed'
   | 'reveal_open'
   | 'reveal_closed'
   | 'tally_final'
   | 'expired'
   | 'aborted';
 
 export interface CourtVoteFailure {
   readonly phase: 'expired' | 'aborted';
   readonly reason: string;
 }
 
 export interface CourtVoteCommitRecord {
   readonly idx: number;
   readonly commitHash: string;
   readonly eventId: string;
 }
 
 export interface CourtVoteRevealRecord {
   readonly idx: number;
   readonly outcome: string;
   readonly salt: string;
   readonly eventId: string;
 }
 
 export interface CourtVerdict {
   readonly outcome: string;
   /** Supporting reveal event ids, sorted lexicographically for canonical hashing. */
   readonly supportingEventIds: readonly string[];
   readonly verdictHash: string;
 }
 
 export interface CourtVoteMachineState {
   readonly sessionHash: string;
   readonly participantIndices: readonly number[];
   readonly allowedOutcomes: readonly string[];
   readonly commitDeadline: number;
   readonly revealDeadline: number;
+  /** Greatest caller-supplied timestamp accepted by the reducer. */
+  readonly latestTimestamp: number;
   readonly phase: CourtVotePhase;
   readonly commits: readonly CourtVoteCommitRecord[];
   readonly reveals: readonly CourtVoteRevealRecord[];
   readonly verdict?: CourtVerdict;
   readonly failure?: CourtVoteFailure;
 }
 
 export type CourtVoteMachineEvent =
   | {
       readonly type: 'accept_commit';
       readonly idx: number;
       readonly commitHash: string;
       readonly eventId: string;
       readonly now: number;
     }
   | { readonly type: 'close_commits'; readonly now: number }
   | { readonly type: 'open_reveals'; readonly now: number }
   | {
       readonly type: 'accept_reveal';
       readonly idx: number;
       readonly outcome: string;
       readonly salt: string;
       readonly eventId: string;
       readonly now: number;
     }
   | { readonly type: 'close_reveals'; readonly now: number }
   | { readonly type: 'finalize_tally'; readonly now: number }
   | { readonly type: 'tick'; readonly now: number }
   | { readonly type: 'abort'; readonly reason: string };
 
 export class CourtVoteTransitionError extends Error {
   constructor(message: string) {
     super(message);
     this.name = 'CourtVoteTransitionError';
   }
 }
 
 const textEncoder = new TextEncoder();
 const HEX_32 = /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/;
 const MAX_OUTCOMES = 256;
 const MAX_OUTCOME_BYTES = 256;
 
 const TERMINAL_PHASES = new Set<CourtVotePhase>(['tally_final', 'expired', 'aborted']);
 
 /**
  * Canonical session-bound vote commitment hash.
  *
  * Binding the session hash into every commit makes votes unreplayable across
  * disputes, attempts, and crypto suites. The encoding is length-prefixed so
  * outcome/salt boundaries can never be ambiguous.
  */
 export function hashCourtVoteCommit(params: {
   readonly sessionHash: string;
   readonly outcome: string;
   readonly salt: string;
 }): string {
   const writer = new CanonicalWriter();
   writer.hex(params.sessionHash);
   writer.text(params.outcome);
   writer.hex(params.salt);
   return digestDomain(COURT_VOTE_COMMIT_DOMAIN, writer.finish());
 }
 
 /**
  * Canonical verdict hash binding the session, the winning outcome, and the
  * exact supporting reveal event ids.
  */
 export function hashCourtVerdict(params: {
   readonly sessionHash: string;
   readonly outcome: string;
   readonly supportingEventIds: readonly string[];
 }): string {
   const writer = new CanonicalWriter();
   writer.hex(params.sessionHash);
   writer.text(params.outcome);
   writer.u32(params.supportingEventIds.length);
   for (const eventId of params.supportingEventIds) {
     writer.hex(eventId);
   }
   return digestDomain(COURT_VERDICT_DOMAIN, writer.finish());
 }
 
 function digestDomain(domain: string, encoded: Uint8Array): string {
   const prefix = textEncoder.encode(domain);
   const input = new Uint8Array(prefix.length + encoded.length);
   input.set(prefix, 0);
   input.set(encoded, prefix.length);
   return bytesToHex(sha256(input));
 }
 
 /**
  * Canonical dispute verdict commitment — the statement a kind-39007
  * attestation binds into its signed message.
  *
  * `H(DisputeVerdict/v1, disputeId, outcome, count, sorted reveal event ids)`
  * over canonical length-prefixed fields. Order-independent (event ids are
  * sorted before hashing) and unambiguous, so every juror, coordinator, and
  * observer derives the same commitment from the same public vote ledger. Any
  * observer can recompute it from the attestation's supporting `e` tags and
  * verify the court really attested the tally winner.
  */
 export function hashDisputeVerdict(params: {
   readonly disputeId: string;
   readonly outcome: string;
   readonly supportingEventIds: readonly string[];
 }): string {
   const writer = new CanonicalWriter();
   writer.hex(params.disputeId);
   writer.text(params.outcome);
   const sorted = [...params.supportingEventIds].sort();
   writer.u32(sorted.length);
   for (const id of sorted) {
     writer.hex(id);
   }
   return digestDomain(COURT_DISPUTE_VERDICT_DOMAIN, writer.finish());
 }
 
 function assertNow(now: number): void {
   if (!Number.isSafeInteger(now) || now < 0) {
     throw new CourtVoteTransitionError('now must be a non-negative Unix timestamp');
   }
 }
 
 function assertParticipant(state: CourtVoteMachineState, idx: number): void {
   if (!state.participantIndices.includes(idx)) {
     throw new CourtVoteTransitionError(`voter ${idx} is outside the certified roster`);
   }
 }
 
 function assertBeforeDeadline(now: number, deadline: number, message: string): void {
   assertNow(now);
   if (now >= deadline) {
     throw new CourtVoteTransitionError(message);
   }
 }
 
 export function createCourtVoteMachine(params: {
   readonly sessionHash: string;
   readonly participantIndices: readonly number[];
   readonly allowedOutcomes: readonly string[];
   readonly commitDeadline: number;
   readonly revealDeadline: number;
 }): CourtVoteMachineState {
   if (!HEX_32.test(params.sessionHash)) {
     throw new CourtVoteTransitionError('sessionHash must be 32-byte lowercase hex');
   }
   if (params.participantIndices.length === 0) {

# Define a canonical Unicode tie-break ordering
**#240126**
- Severity: High
